_description: Mage Training Arena (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Training_Arena and its room pages, Pizazz_points, Progress_hat, Entrance_Guardian). Names are cache gamevals; tiles are the map's. Values under a `_calibrated` note have no Wiki figure.

lobby._bounds: the entrance hall on both floors (the Rewards Guardian is upstairs)

enchant._spells: points per enchant = the spell's level; every 10th shape doubles it, the bonus shape adds 2 after; a dragonstone is twice the spell's level

messages._unverified: the Wiki gives no capture for these except the guardian's bonus lines
messages.level: You need a Magic level of {level} to enter the {room}.
messages.bonusShape: The bonus shape has changed to the {shape}.
messages.inventoryFull: You don't have enough inventory space.
messages.pointsCapped: You can't hold any more {type} Pizazz Points.
messages.orbsDeposited: You deposit {count} orb{s} into the hole.
messages.runesForOrbs: You receive {amount} {rune} for the orbs you deposited.
messages.itemsTaken: The arena's items vanish as you leave.
messages.noCoins: You can't take coins into the Alchemists' Playground.
messages.deposited: You deposit {coins} coin{cs} and earn {points} Alchemist Pizazz Point{s}.
messages.nothingToDeposit: You don't have any coins to deposit.
messages.coinsToBank: {coins} coins have been added to your bank.
messages._free: the guardian's own spellings for the items (Wiki, Alchemy_Guardian)
messages.peachesLocked: You have to unlock that spell to use it inside of Mage Training Arena.
messages.noFruit: You don't have any fruit to deposit.
messages.fruitDeposited: You deposit {fruit} fruit and earn {points} Graveyard Pizazz Point{s}.
messages.runesForFruit: You receive {amount} {rune} for the fruit you deposited.
messages.noRunes: You do not have enough runes to cast this spell.
messages.noFruitIn: You can't take fruit or bones into the Creature Graveyard.
messages._graveyard: noBones and peachesLocked are the Wiki's; the rest have no capture
messages.rewardsNoHat: Well, you need to talk to him first.
messages.shopTooPoor: You don't have enough Pizazz Points to buy that.
messages.shopUnlocked: You have unlocked the Bones to Peaches spell.
messages.shopAlreadyUnlocked: You have already unlocked Bones to Peaches.
messages.shopPeachesLevel: You need a Magic level of 60 to learn Bones to Peaches.
messages.shopHavePouch: You already have a rune pouch.
messages.shopNoRoom: You don't have enough inventory space.
messages._shop: rewardsNoHat is the Wiki's transcript line; the shop's own messages have no capture

alchemists._bounds: plane 2 of the arena's basement (the Enchanting Chamber is plane 0, the Graveyard plane 1)
alchemists._items: the five items in the cupboards' fixed clockwise order, then the empty one; the overlay lists them in this order
alchemists._calibrated: how often an item is free to convert: the Wiki says only 'sometimes'

graveyard._piles: each pile type gives the next bone after every 4 taken from it (Wiki); the count is kept per player
graveyard._fruit: fruit per bone: version 1 gives 1, version 4 gives 4
graveyard._fruitPerPoint: a peach counts as 2 fruit; the rest is a chance of one more point

shop._enums: the shop's own clientscripts read these (3255: the stock; 3260: one price enum per type and the wands' previous tier); they have no gameval names
shop._varps: the points the shop shows (3260 reads 261 as Telekinetic, 262 Alchemist, 263 Enchantment, 264 Graveyard) and the selected quantity (2224)
shop._mostAtOnce: the fourth quantity button: client script 2930 sets the quantity varp to 28 for this shop
